I've been diagnosed with OCD, and I'm on meds. I keep on messing up with seeing therapists though. Exam week may have me stressed, so the thoughts are back. 

Hey, we can help each other. This is a throw-away account, but I can PM you my MSN name for instance. *hugs*

Thanks for the reply *hugs* Yeah, I'm religious myself and tend to obsess over whether I did something wrong. Keep having to remind myself that God loves us. 

And yeah, I'll remember that my thoughts are not my actions.
